controls.name: identity / untouched mixture
controls.role: The mixture itself is the preservation baseline; a selected-output claim must justify target gain without unexplained target damage.

controls.name: generic denoiser control (DeepFilterNet3)
controls.role: A matched generic enhancement control shows what ordinary denoising does to target SI-SDR/STOI; it has no speaker cue and is not extraction.

controls.name: unenrolled competing-speaker suppressor (Hush)
controls.role: Hush attenuates a primary/background mixture without an enrollment prompt; it is a suppression control, not a target-selection candidate.

controls.name: degenerate target-only and target-absent diagnostics
controls.role: Always-emit-target and always-emit-non-target behaviour must expose target false acceptance and target false rejection; neither is a product candidate.

controls.name: target/masker ratio versus target-quality separation
controls.role: A better target/masker projection ratio does not compensate for lower target SI-SDR or STOI; the two outcomes are reported separately.

controls.name: cue-facet separation (enrollment / spatial / visual)
controls.role: Enrollment, spatial and visual cues are distinct input facets and cannot be compared or pooled without a declared protocol.

controls.name: unknown and unenrolled region handling
controls.role: Time without an enrolled target or annotation is unknown, never automatically non-target; an unenrolled region is not a negative label.

controls.name: sample-count, finite-output and identity preservation
controls.role: Every extracted output must keep the declared sample count, stay finite and avoid hidden audio mutation; identity PCM remains the fallback.

controls.name: generic separation permutation and source-count control
controls.role: Separation output order, permutation and source count must be resolved before any source can be called the requested speaker.
